aboutH2: Sunshine Coast Health Centre: Meaning-Centred Care for Men
intro: Sunshine Coast Health Centre approach promotes an individual’s control over their own recovery process and combines evidence-based therapeutic modalities. For example, their Meaning-Centered Therapy program helps clients explore their personal values, goals, and vision for their future to pave the way for a fulfilling life after treatment. Sunshine Coast’s team recognizes that each client faces unique challenges, and they create customized treatment plans for each. They work closely with clients to establish goals, implement strategies, and monitor their progress.

pillars.title: Treatment Programs and Amenities
pillars.body: Sunshine Coast Health Centre offers a range of treatment programs, including a primary care program, extended care program, and a recovery enhancement program. Each program is designed to accommodate the specific needs of clients and provide comprehensive treatment. They also provide options for individual therapy, group therapy, and family therapy. Sunshine Coast Health Centre’s amenities include comfortable private rooms, nutritious meals cooked on-site, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, recreational activities, and more. They strive to make their clients comfortable in their new environment, and activities like swimming, hiking, and kayaking are part of the treatment program.

pillars.title: Client Success Stories
pillars.body: Sunshine Coast Health Centre is proud of the successes their clients have achieved through the tailored care and support they offer. One of their greatest achievements is helping clients gain the courage to take control of their lives in a healthy and meaningful way. Many of their alumni have become community advocates and have motivated other people to seek treatment. One client gave the following testimony, “the staff here is top notch, and they genuinely care about your progress. This is a very special place, and I can’t thank them enough for giving me the tools that I needed to finally get my life back.”

pillars.title: Nine Oceanfront Acres South of Powell River
pillars.body: The centre sits on more than nine acres of private oceanfront just south of Powell River, looking across the Strait of Georgia toward Vancouver Island. Men live in residences with private bedrooms and spend their days between the main clinical building, the Cliffside Building for rTMS, massage and extra counselling, and a fitness centre right on the water where clients sometimes spot whales and dolphins going by. There's a pool, a basketball court, a beach and firepits on the patio. Staff also take clients into town for movies, shopping, hockey games and local events, which keeps a month away from home from feeling like a lockdown.

overviewH2: Sunshine Coast Health Centre: Center Overview
overview: Sunshine Coast Health Centre offers comprehensive treatment options for individuals struggling with drug addiction, alcoholism, PTSD, and trauma. With a team of over 50 credentialed, certified, and licensed professionals on staff, the centre provides 24-hour medical care, psychology, psychiatry, nutrition and fitness support, and specialized body work to ensure clients receive the best possible care. The centre has an incredible track record and has helped over 4,492 individuals overcome their addictions and improve their mental health since 2004.

Unlike many rehabilitation centres, Sunshine Coast Health Centre does not rely solely on the traditional 12-step program. Instead, the centre utilizes evidence-based treatments to help guide clients towards recovery. The men’s program at the centre brings together a team of highly-trained professionals who work to provide support to motivated men struggling with their mental health. With a staff-to-client ratio of 3 to 1, clients can rest assured that their care will be personalized and comprehensive throughout their journey towards healing.
serviceCaption: 12 services · aftercare and family sessions at no extra cost
afterOverview: A separate trauma program serves first responders, military members and veterans, including paramedics, firefighters and RCMP and police officers. It combines dedicated trauma groups, psychiatric care, one-on-one talk therapy, EMDR, DBT and rTMS, and it runs alongside the addiction program so men can work on both at once. Indigenous clients have a dedicated Indigenous Support Person and access to practices such as smudging and spiritual water bathing, and the centre has a long-standing, informal relationship with elders from the Tla’amin Nation, just north of Powell River. Clients can keep their phones and laptops, and many use them after programming hours to keep up with work.

location.heading: Sunshine Coast Health Centre in Powell River, British Columbia
location.intro: The centre is on the water just south of Powell River, in the qathet Regional District at the top of BC's Sunshine Coast. From Vancouver it's about a 25-minute flight or around 5 hours by road with the Horseshoe Bay and Earls Cove ferries, while men coming from Nanaimo or elsewhere on Vancouver Island can drive to Comox and take the 90-minute ferry to Powell River.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Sunshine Coast Health Centre cost?
faqs.a: The centre doesn't publish its fees online; admissions coordinators share the fee schedule by phone at 1-866-487-9010. Its recovery.com profile lists an estimated cash-pay rate of $29,000 to $30,000 CAD for 30 days. Alumni services after treatment are included in that cost.

Most men stay at least 30 days, counted from the point the doctor clears them to start programming after any medical withdrawal. Stays are flexible, and many clients extend by a few weeks or a couple of months. Men who leave at 30 days are encouraged to have counselling set up in their home community first.

faqs.q: Does the centre offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Withdrawal management happens on site in an 8-bed Medical Unit with nurses on duty around the clock, so you don't need to be sober before you arrive. You see a doctor within 24 hours and usually stay 1 to 5 days before programming starts, with protocols matched to the substances you've used, including opioid agonist treatment such as Suboxone. A 7-day Medical Program is also offered to men going on to outpatient treatment at home.

faqs.q: Where is the centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 2174 Fleury Road, just south of Powell River on BC's Sunshine Coast. From Vancouver it's about a 25-minute flight, or around 5 hours by road with two BC Ferries crossings, and there's also a ferry to Powell River from Comox on Vancouver Island. Admissions arranges airport transfers and airport or ferry pick-ups free of charge, and staff in Vancouver can help you change terminals.

Aftercare is included in the cost of treatment and has no end date. Alumni get recovery coaching in person in several Canadian cities or by phone or Zoom, weekly support meetings led by counsellors and coaches, 24-hour phone or text support, free refresher weekends and alumni dinners. Families can join a weekly Virtual Family Session during or after the stay, also at no charge.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it's a private, fee-based centre, and many clients are covered through extended health benefits. The centre works with most insurers and benefit plans and takes referrals from organizations such as VAC, CF, the RCMP and WorkSafe. Payments can be split across credit cards, wire transfer or several funders, financing is available, and people paying for treatment may be able to claim it on their income tax.

faqs.q: Is Sunshine Coast Health Centre only for men?
faqs.a: Yes, Sunshine Coast Health Centre is a men-only facility.

faqs.q: What is the capacity of Sunshine Coast Health Centre?
faqs.a: Sunshine Coast Health Centre has a small admission size, which allows for individualized care and attention.

faqs.q: What is the approach to treatment at Sunshine Coast Health Centre?
faqs.a: Sunshine Coast Health Centre uses a non-12-Step treatment philosophy that combines evidence-based therapeutic modalities and promotes an individual’s control over their own recovery process.

faqs.q: What kind of healthcare professionals work at Sunshine Coast Health Centre?
faqs.a: The impressive range of staff at Sunshine Coast Health Centre includes nurses, therapists, wellness therapists, and psychiatrists with experience treating mental health and addiction.

faqs.q: What kind of treatment programs are offered at Sunshine Coast Health Centre?
faqs.a: Sunshine Coast Health Centre offers a range of programs, including primary care, extended care, and recovery enhancement programs, as well as individual, group, and family therapy.

faqs.q: Are there recreational activities offered at Sunshine Coast Health Centre?
faqs.a: Yes, Sunshine Coast Health Centre provides indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, as well as recreational activities such as swimming, hiking, and kayaking.

faqs.q: Does Sunshine Coast Health Centre provide private rooms?
faqs.a: Yes, Sunshine Coast Health Centre provides comfortable private rooms.

faqs.q: How is privacy maintained at Sunshine Coast Health Centre?
faqs.a: Sunshine Coast Health Centre is located on nine beautiful acres with a private oceanfront on British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast, allowing for privacy.
